summary_1line: Sages tell Rama of the Asura Madhu, Shiva’s gifted spear, and his cruel son Lavana who now terrorizes the world and needs to be stopped.

image_candidates.scene_text: Shiva, holding his trident, grants a blazing spear to the kneeling Asura Madhu as the gods look on.
The cruel Lavana brandishes the inherited spear while terrified sages flee through a forest hermitage.
Ascetics on the banks of the Yamuna plead with Rama to save them from Lavana’s terror.
